list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list: 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this tracker and cites where its facts come from.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 · the first meditation
roadmap.summary: Play the opening chapter, take Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth, beat Cal at fishing. Keep a manual save before the chapter ends.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 · partners & garages
roadmap.summary: Breakfast Run unlocks partner switching. Buy garages once Daily Driver opens the Real Estate app and start registering cheap cars with Scooter Bros.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 · Vice City
roadmap.summary: Race Yago as soon as he appears, rob shops back-to-back with your partner and pick a jewelry store back door with the Snap Gun.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 · vaults
roadmap.summary: Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to open the bank vaults; begin the five-vault run.

roadmap.title: Story missions & finale
roadmap.summary: The named story missions and the final mission. None can be missed, but there is no replay: keep a save before the last mission.

roadmap.title: Character strands
roadmap.summary: Finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, Bret's unique hunt and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. These stay open after the credits.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.summary: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicle discoveries and the full map.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.summary: Stunts, Shooting Range golds, Top Fun drone races, races, arcade, challenges.

roadmap.title: Crime & cleanup
roadmap.summary: Heists, gang operations, laundering, the oddball hidden trophies and partner stunts.

roadmap.title: 100% & the Platinum
roadmap.summary: Close out the in-game 100% checklist under Progress > Stats, then the Platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.location: Unlocks automatically the moment the 54th trophy pops.
trophies.guide: The Platinum is a reward for clearing the other 54 trophies; nothing extra is asked of you. Launch guides put a full run at roughly 200 hours of mostly long, not hard, play with no difficulty setting and no online trophies [2][3]. Only one trophy is flagged as potentially missable (Positive Mental Attitude), so one careful playthrough with chapter saves is enough [3].
steps: Follow the Roadmap tab in order: story first, then strands, collectibles, activities and cleanup [3].
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; there is no mission replay or New Game Plus [2][4].
Do not enter cheats on your trophy save: they switch off trophies and saving [2][4].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.location: Gone Fishing, the opening story mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the very first mission, Gone Fishing [3]. It is scripted and comes with normal progress, so it cannot be skipped or missed [4].
steps: Start a new game and finish Gone Fishing [3].
Make your first manual save right after it: the save habit pays off later in Chapter 1 [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.location: End of Chapter 1; it may only pop as Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1; Output Lag notes it can appear a moment late, at the start of Chapter 2 [2]. Before you trigger the last Chapter 1 mission, make sure Lucia's balcony meditation is done, because that is the one moment in the game guides flag as a point of no return [2][3].
steps: Accept Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house after Down to Earth [3].
Save manually, then play the chapter's final mission [2].
Keep that Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude has popped [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.location: End of Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Chapter-completion trophy for Chapter 2 [1][2]. Chapter 2 is also where the Real Estate app (after Daily Driver) and the Scooter Bros app (after Moses) open, so buy garages and register cars while you are here rather than in one long grind at the end [2].
steps: Play through Chapter 2's story missions [2].
Pick up garages and a few cheap cars for On the Spot along the way [2].
Save at the start of Chapter 3 [3].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.location: End of Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 3 is done [1][3]. The chapter itself cannot be missed, but one optional thing inside it can: Race Against Yago, a Strangers & Freaks strand that Output Lag calls time-sensitive. Do it as soon as it is offered [2].
steps: Race Yago as soon as he shows up on the map [2].
Rob three shops in a row with your partner for Retail Therapy while the chapter is active [2].
Finish the chapter's last mission and save [3].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.location: End of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 completion [1][2]. Late in this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults needed for Maximum Withdrawal, so take it when it appears [2][3].
steps: Accept That's Where The Money Is when it is offered near the end of the chapter [2].
Finish the chapter and keep a manual save before the last chapter begins [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.location: The last story mission (CULTR files it under Chapter 5).
trophies.guide: Gold for beating the final mission [1][3]. Free roam carries on after the credits, so every open-world trophy is still there afterwards [4]. Missions cannot be replayed, so keep an untouched save from just before the finale in case you want to see it again [2].
steps: Make a dedicated save just before the final mission [2].
Finish the mission and watch the credits [3].
Carry on in free roam for the cleanup stages [4].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.location: Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 [2]. It matters beyond the trophy: switching between Jason and Lucia opens after this mission, and the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best) depend on that [2].
steps: Finish Breakfast Run [2].
Try a character switch right away so you know the partner controls before Chapter 3 [2].

sources.name: GTABoom: Every GTA 6 Trophy at Launch

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.location: The Cartel Heist story mission.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: finish the story mission The Cartel Heist [1]. Launch guides list it with the unmissable story trophies but have not yet tied it to a chapter, so this tracker places it with the other named missions [2][3].
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist is offered [3].
Complete it; the trophy pops on the mission result [2].

sources.name: GTABoom: Every GTA 6 Trophy at Launch

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.location: Child's Play story mission.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: complete the story mission Child's Play [1]. It is one of the hidden story trophies that sources call unmissable; no chapter has been published for it yet [2][3].
steps: Progress the main story until Child's Play [3].
Finish the mission [2].

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.location: Headliners story mission.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: finish the story mission Headliners [1]. Sources list it among the unmissable story trophies without a confirmed chapter [2][3].
steps: Follow the main story to Headliners [3].
Complete the mission [2].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.location: VCIA Takedown story mission (VCIA is Vice City International Airport).
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: complete VCIA Takedown [1]. VCIA is the airport, which is also where Catch Me If You Can is earned in free roam, so it is worth learning the boarding gates during this mission [2][3].
steps: Play the story to VCIA Takedown and finish it [3].
Later, return to the same airport for Catch Me If You Can [2].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.location: Operation Savage Glory story mission.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: finish Operation Savage Glory [1]. Listed as an unmissable story trophy; launch sources do not yet say which chapter holds it [2][3].
steps: Advance the main story until Operation Savage Glory [3].
Complete the mission [2].

sources.name: GTABoom: Every GTA 6 Trophy at Launch

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableWhen: Some optional missions close during parts of the story, but the checklist asks for 100 optional tasks out of a larger pool, so a few missed ones do not lock you out.
trophies.location: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion shows what is left once the story is over.
trophies.guide: The longest trophy in the list: the in-game 100% checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats after the story [2][3]. The checklist does not ask for everything: for example 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 42 of 42 range golds and 42 drone time trials [3]. On the crime side it wants 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 22 Bank Jobs and $250,000 of Marked Bills fenced [2][3].
steps: Finish the story so the checklist becomes visible [2].
Work through it by category; the counts above are the targets, not the totals [3].
Use the Collectibles and Activities stages of the roadmap; most of their trophies feed this one [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.location: Stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all over Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stunts are a broad category: ramp jumps, passing under bridges, knife-edge flying and base jumps all count [2]. You need 250 for this trophy, but the 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past the pop [2][3].
steps: Log stunts whenever you pass one while driving or flying [2].
Push on to 300 if you are going for A Long Road [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.location: Activity icons across the map.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once; you do not have to win. KeenGamer counts nine activity types [3]. It usually pops during the Activities stage when you start the range, drone races, fishing, arcade and the rest [2][3].
steps: Start one of each activity type you see on the map [3].
Use the counter here to track types tried [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.location: Two shooting ranges, 42 challenges in all.
trophies.guide: Gold every challenge at both ranges: 42 golds in total [2][3]. At 25 golds you unlock a No Reload cheat; leave it off, since any cheat disables trophies [4].
steps: Visit both ranges and work through the challenges [2].
Retry the ones that miss gold; there is no penalty for retries [3].
Never activate the No Reload reward on this save [4].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.location: 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations [2][3]. 100% also wants all 42 drone time trials, so do them on the same visit [3].
steps: Mark each Top Fun icon and win its race [2].
Clear that spot's time trials while you are there [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.location: Race events across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races; repeating the same one does not add up [1][2]. 100% asks for 30 of 40 unique race wins and 10 of 13 race golds, so the trophy comes on the way [3].
steps: Pick a fast car you have registered and win new races [2].
Track distinct wins with the counter [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.location: Fishing challenge against Cal; it shows on the Chapter 1 checklist.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Output Lag places it on the Chapter 1 checklist, so it fits alongside the opening hours [2]. Losing costs nothing: just challenge him again [3].
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge once Chapter 1 opens it [2].
Out-fish him; retry if you lose [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.location: Any arcade cabinet; there are four games.
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four arcade games [2]. 100% wants all four played, so try each one while you are at the cabinets [3].
steps: Find an arcade and finish one game [2].
Play the other three for the 100% list [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.location: Andy's character strand, played as Lucia.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand to its last mission; it is a Lucia-only strand [2]. Character strands stay open after the credits, and Andy's does not count toward the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands [2][3].
steps: Switch to Lucia and pick up Andy's missions [2].
Play them to the final one [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.location: Kenton's character strand; Kenton is also tied to the treasure-diving sets.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's last mission; the strand remains available after the story [2]. 100% wants 5 of 7 of Kenton's treasure sets, so combine dives with his missions [3][4].
steps: Start Kenton's strand when it appears [2].
Finish his final mission [3].
Dive for his treasure sets while in the area [4].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.location: Billy's character strand.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's strand to its last mission [1][2]. It stays open after the credits, and like Andy's and Tyrone's it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [2][3].
steps: Pick up Billy's missions [2].
Finish the last one [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableWhen: Race Against Yago, a qualifying strand, is time-sensitive in Chapter 3. Take it as soon as it is offered so you do not have to find a replacement strand later.
trophies.location: Stranger icons across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's character strands do not count, but the Yago race does, and Output Lag calls it time-sensitive [2]. KeenGamer leaves this for late in the run, after the character strands [3].
steps: Race Yago as soon as he appears in Chapter 3 [2].
Pick up stranger icons as they show up; keep the count here [2].
Finish the remaining strands in free roam after the story [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.location: Randy's character strand.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission Randy offers [1][2]. His strand stays open once the story is over, so it fits in the post-story cleanup [2][3].
steps: Start Randy's strand [2].
Play it to the end [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.location: Tyrone's character strand, played as Jason.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only; finish its last mission [2]. Like Andy's, it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [2][3].
steps: Switch to Jason and take Tyrone's missions [2].
Finish the final one [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableWhen: Lucia's first meditation, on the balcony of Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth, is offered only in Chapter 1. Once Chapter 1 ends it cannot be done again. Sources have not confirmed it counts, so do it to be safe.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: End of Chapter 1 (after Down to Earth)
trophies.location: Balcony at Jason's house (Ch 1), then 17 more marked spots across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy launch guides flag as possibly missable [3][4]. KeenGamer puts the requirement at 18 spots: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony session plus 17 spots you can visit any time as Jason or Lucia, and both characters may use the same spot [3]. Output Lag adds an unconfirmed report that outdoor spots count twice, once per character [2].
steps: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's invite to the balcony at Jason's house and finish the session [3][4].
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops [2].
Visit the remaining spots in free roam; tick them off with the counter here [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.location: Bret's hunting contracts, played as Jason.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting line is Jason-only; bring in one of his unique animals [2]. A clean shot to the head or heart keeps the carcass pristine, which is what he wants [2]. 100% also lists all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, so carry on with his contracts afterwards [3].
steps: Take Bret's contracts as Jason [2].
Track the unique animal and drop it with a head or heart shot [2].
Finish his Target Decks for the 100% list [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.location: Collectible cards across Leonida: 18 sets, 480 cards in all.
trophies.guide: Complete any three full card sets [1][3]. There are 18 sets and about 480 cards [4]. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so plan one big sweep instead of three small ones [3].
steps: Pick three sets and collect every card in them [3].
Count finished sets here; keep collecting toward 15 sets for 100% [3][4].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.location: 100 WAiNK spots around the map; scans also log vehicles.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations [1][3]. WAiNK scans also count toward Whip It Good's vehicle discoveries, so the two progress together [2]. The 100% checklist asks for the same 100 [3].
steps: WAiNK every marked spot you pass [3].
Point it at unfamiliar cars too: it logs them for Whip It Good [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.location: Progress > Challenges menu.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 entries from the Challenges list under Progress > Challenges [2]. It comes well before the 70 of 80 that 100% wants [3][4].
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and pick off easy ones [2].
Keep going to 70 for A Long Road [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.location: Anywhere with both Jason and Lucia together.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, reach four stars and shake them off [1][2]. The trophy arrives once you are fully out of the red heat zone, not when the stars start flashing [2]. Save first; four stars gets lethal fast [3].
steps: Save, then cause trouble with your partner until four stars [2].
Break line of sight and leave the red zone until the stars clear [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.location: Three nearby shops; Output Lag ties it to Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while your Wanted Level is still active; the chain breaks if the stars drop [2]. Pick three stores close together, and give it around 30 seconds after the last one before you worry, since it can pop late [2].
steps: Scout three shops a short drive apart [2].
Rob them one after another without losing the stars [2].
Wait for the delayed pop, then escape [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.location: Vehicles across Leonida: 277 base models.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles; WAiNK scans count, so you do not have to drive each one [2]. 100% asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so start early and let it build up in the background [2][3].
steps: Scan or enter new vehicles as you meet them [2].
Use the counter; aim for 200 for A Long Road [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.location: Any firefight with five or more enemies.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is triggered by pressing L3 and R3 together while aiming [2]. Use it once in a crowded fight and drop five enemies before it runs out [2][3].
steps: Let the focus meter fill [2].
Aim, press L3 + R3, and chain five quick takedowns [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.location: Vice City International Airport boarding bridges; gates E3 and E4 are reported to work.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet from a VCIA boarding bridge, take off and fly about a kilometre away [2][3]. Output Lag reports gates E3 and E4 working. Police respond quickly and the trophy is delayed, so save before you try [2].
steps: Save, then head to the airport's boarding bridges [2].
Board a parked airliner and get it airborne [3].
Fly roughly 1 km clear and wait for the pop [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.location: South side of Mile Zero Air Station, where the military tanks are parked.
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank. Output Lag places the tanks on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station [2]. KeenGamer describes it as stealing a Rhino and using it in a fight, so drive it out and fire a few shells to be sure [3]. Save first: the base is guarded [2].
steps: Save, then approach Mile Zero Air Station from the south [2].
Climb into a Rhino [2].
Drive it off base and use it in combat if the trophy has not popped [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.location: Any jewelry store's back door; the safe code is in the back room.
trophies.guide: Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's back door rather than kicking it in; kicking sets off the alarm [2]. The safe code is in the back room. Stay out of sight and leave with the goods [2][3].
steps: Go to a jewelry store's rear entrance with the Snap Gun (Ch 3) [2].
Pick the lock, read the safe code in the back room [2].
Empty the safe and slip out unseen [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.location: Eight large bank vaults, opened by the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.guide: The vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission late in Chapter 4 [2][3]. Rob five and get away clean; bring your partner along [2]. 100% wants all eight [3].
steps: Accept That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4 [2][3].
Rob five vaults with your partner and escape each time [2].
Finish the other three for A Long Road [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.location: Armored trucks on Leonida's roads.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck, then get out of the red heat zone; the trophy waits until you have escaped [2]. It is a single robbery, so one well-planned hit is enough [1][3].
steps: Save, then intercept an armored truck [2].
Grab the cash and leave the red zone [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.location: The whole state map.
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole Leonida map [3]. It comes naturally while you chase collectibles; at the end, check the map for dark patches and fly over them [1][3].
steps: Explore while collecting [3].
Fly over any unrevealed corners at the end [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.location: Gang operations of 9 gangs; 39 operations in all.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs [2][3]. 100% asks for all 39 gang operations, so it is worth clearing every one you find [3].
steps: Find an operation for each gang [2].
Tick a gang off here after each robbery [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.location: A bar or terrace with a view on Ocean Beach (derived from the official description).
trophies.guide: No source has confirmed the trigger yet [2][3]. Going by the official description, order a drink somewhere overlooking Ocean Beach [1]. The tracker will update this guide when a method is published.
steps: Head to Ocean Beach [1].
Find a bar or terrace facing the sea and order a cocktail [1].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.location: A vehicle showroom (derived from the official description).
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet [2][3]. From the official description: take a car from a showroom floor and drive it straight out through the front glass [1]. Save beforehand in case the trigger needs a specific showroom.
steps: Save, then enter a vehicle showroom [1].
Get into a display car and drive it through the window [1].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.location: Kingpin Bowling (the Kolt & Associates' alley), robbed in Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, using Sticky Bombs, and take all three valuables, the office safe included [2][3]. If you leave loot behind, the operation comes back and you can try again, so it cannot be missed [2].
steps: Bring Sticky Bombs to Kingpin Bowling (Ch 2) [2].
Take the three valuables, including the office safe [2][3].
Escape with all of it [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.location: A gym with a membership, training with your partner.
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia [2][3]. Buy a gym membership and train together with your partner; Output Lag says the trophy should pop once both are maxed [2].
steps: Get a gym membership [2].
Train with your partner until both have max Strength [2][3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.location: Anywhere: every action that changes your Criminal Profile counts.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; robberies and fights both count [2][3]. It builds up on its own over a normal run [2].
steps: Play normally; crimes and fights move the Criminal Profile [2].
Track progress against 500 [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.location: Not yet published.
trophies.guide: No launch source has a confirmed method [2][3]. All we have is the official hint that something works on the second attempt [1]. It has not been flagged as missable, so leave it for cleanup and check back as guides update.
steps: Leave for the cleanup stage [3].
Treat any method you find online as unconfirmed until several sources agree [2].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.location: Not yet published.
trophies.guide: The trigger is still unconfirmed [2][3]. The name and the official description suggest a strange, possibly paranormal event in the open world [1]. It is not flagged as missable.
steps: Keep an eye out for odd events while exploring [1].
Wait for confirmed methods before chasing it [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.location: Anywhere with pedestrians, while riding a bike or motorcycle.
trophies.guide: KeenGamer describes it as a melee drive-by takedown, with the exact method still being confirmed [3]. From the official description, hit someone with a melee attack while riding past [1]. Output Lag lists it as unconfirmed [2].
steps: Get on a bike or motorcycle [1].
Ride past a pedestrian and land a melee hit [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.location: Marked Bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; launder them through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills drop from bank jobs and payday-loan jobs; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 adds up [2]. 100% asks for the same $250,000 fenced, plus 22 Bank Jobs and 7 Payday Loan Jobs [3].
steps: Run bank and payday-loan jobs for Marked Bills [2].
Fence them through your contacts after each run [2][3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.location: Any shop; the total adds up across purchases.
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 in shops; it adds up over time [2][3]. Clothes, weapons and upgrades all add to it, so it usually pops on its own late in the run [2].
steps: Buy what you need as you go [2].
Top up with a shopping spree once you are rich [3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.location: Vice City Real Estate app, unlocked by the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after Daily Driver in Chapter 2 [2][3]. Expect about $160,000 in total, and note that garages the story gives you do not count [2]. Buying early also gives you space for On the Spot registrations [2].
steps: Finish Daily Driver (Ch 2) to unlock the app [2].
Buy each of the eight garages as cash allows [2][3].

sources.name: KeenGamer: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.location: Scooter Bros app, opened by the Chapter 2 mission Moses; the standard tracker arrives in Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through Scooter Bros [1][3]. The app opens with Moses in Chapter 2, and each registration needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars [2].
steps: Unlock the app with Moses (Ch 2) [2].
Buy garage space, then register ten cheap vehicles [2][3].
